# Hex

> Hex is an AI analytics platform for trusted data exploration, agentic notebooks, conversational self-serve analytics, and interactive data apps, with shared context and governance managed by data teams.

Context Studio brings together business definitions, models, and analytical work for agents to use across Hex, Slack, MCP-connected tools, and the CLI. Data teams can inspect agent activity, evaluate context changes, and address gaps in answers.

For research, follow the relevant links below. Public content pages on hex.tech and learn.hex.tech support `Accept: text/markdown`; use the canonical URLs rather than assuming a `.md` suffix. Consult the linked pricing and API documentation for current plans, limits, and permissions.

Hex workspace data is private. Product API calls require a bearer token; MCP access requires the user to authorize an OAuth connection.
